exp16_macro_19y.name: 19-Year Weekly 5-Asset Global Macro Cross-Asset Copula (Exp 16)
data_sources: Ken French 49 Industry Portfolios (equal-weight US equity composite)

bandwidth_bw010_ablation.note: Too-tight bandwidth (bw=0.10) starves tail support and fails 99% ES calibration; maintain bw >= 0.20 and W >= 128.

nyc_lower_manhattan.provenance_note: NYC Lower Manhattan progressive revision benchmark (ZIP 10006 dispatch queue, 2025-11-12..2026-11-12; 4,330 predicted checkpoints plus 10 initial warmup abstentions). Distinct from the separate 4-borough asynchronous-mask benchmark (Exp 31).
nyc_lower_manhattan.data_source: NYC Open Data 311 Service Requests Socrata API (data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.json)

chicago_post_2026_09.data_source: Chicago Data Portal 311 Service Requests Socrata API (data.cityofchicago.org/resource/v6vf-nfxy.json)

exp54_mozilla_bugzilla_thunderbird.mechanism: Single-domain similarity conditioning (bw=0.20) exhibits soft similarity bleed (~6-10 pp of weight from closed-before-cutoff bugs across the hard survival boundary; Rev 2 predicted overrun 70.5% vs actual 81.0%), whereas risk-set-filtered QRF, HGBR, and OLHR hard-partition surviving tickets.

exp59_sf_fire_ems_dispatch.data_source: DataSF Fire Department Calls for Service Socrata API (data.sfgov.org/resource/nuek-vuh3.json)
exp59_sf_fire_ems_dispatch.mechanism: High-cardinality station/call-type interactions under similarity-based conditioning suffer cross-station dilution at early dispatch stages (Rev 0/1) where boosted trees and hazard regression lead; reaches statistical parity at Rev 2 (+25m). Also required stripping post-dispatch final_priority (which changes on 24.69% of calls) to preserve append-only causality.

conditioning_regime_notes.append_only_log_requirement: Upstream operational event logs must stay strictly append-only. Snapshot columns overwritten retroactively (e.g., final priority or final owner department) leak future resolution states and must be excluded or reconstructed solely from immutable revision timestamps.

columns.idx: Zero-based non-overlapping weekly step index (0..929; eval window idx >= 40, n=890)
columns.is_eval_890: 1 if in the 890-week primary evaluation window (idx >= 40), else 0
columns.status: predicted or abstained (7 initial insufficient-support abstentions)
columns.ess: Effective sample size of conditional similarity weights
columns.ess_prior: Effective sample size of uniform archive prior
columns.energy_score: 5D joint Energy Score in vol-standardized return units (lower is better)
columns.es_prior_cf: Unconditioned archive prior 5D Energy Score counterfactual
columns.crps_eq..crps_usd: Marginal 1D CRPS across equity, 10Y yield, VIX, WTI oil, and USD
columns.y_eq, y_vix: Realized vol-standardized 5-day equity return and VIX change
columns.eq_q01..eq_q99, eq_es05, eq_es01, eq_pit: Predictive equity quantiles, left-tail Expected Shortfall estimates, and continuous PIT
columns.gfc_mass_cond, gfc_mass_prior, gfc_ratio: Conditional weight on 2008-09 GFC archive weeks, uniform archive baseline share, and recall ratio (cond/prior)
columns.covid20_mass_cond, covid20_mass_prior: Conditional and prior probability mass placed on 2020 COVID weeks
columns.prior_crisis_mass_cond, prior_crisis_mas: Conditional and prior mass placed on strictly prior crisis episodes
columns.mean_age_yrs_cond, mean_age_yrs_prior, m: Expected and maximum historical analogue age in years

exp16_macro_w0512_bw030_trace.csv.columns: Identical schema to exp16_macro_w1024_bw020_trace.csv for the best-ES sweep arm (W=512, bw=0.30).

columns.model_id: Adapt-1 arm configuration or parametric/FHS comparator name
columns.family: Model family (Adapt-1, GARCH-FHS, GARCH-Gauss, EWMA-FHS, EWMA-Gauss)
columns.window_w, bandwidth, max_support, condit: Adapt-1 memory depth, kernel bandwidth, support cap, and conditioning mode
columns.in_primary_9_sweep: 1 for the 9 primary sweep configs (W >= 128 and bw >= 0.20), else 0
columns.es_5d_full19y..es_5d_tariff_2025: Mean 5D Energy Score over n=890 weeks and regime slices
columns.diff_vs_dcc_fhs, t10_vs_dcc_fhs, sig_bea: Paired ES differential and lag-10 Newey-West HAC t-stat vs DCC-GARCH(1,1)-FHS
columns.var99_breaches..frtb_3of3_pass: Basel FRTB 99% VaR CC, 99% ES Acerbi-Szekely Z2, and PIT KS uniformity results
columns.gfc_covid_peak_ratio: 13-week COVID peak 2008 GFC analogue weight ratio

columns.ticket_hash: Deterministic anonymized ticket hash (tkt_<10-hex>; zero raw IDs or PII) linking progressive revisions of the same ticket
columns.rev, stage_label: Revision stage index (0, 1, 2) and elapsed checkpoint (0h, +1h, +6h)
columns.created_date: Ticket creation date truncated to YYYY-MM-DD
columns.is_oos: 1 for sealed 2026 OOS evaluation tickets (2026-01-01..2026-11-12), 0 for pre-2026 warmup
columns.n_resolved_hist: Count of strictly resolved past tickets in archive at query time
columns.es_mixed, es_mixed_prior_cf: Mixed categorical+duration Energy Score and unconditioned prior counterfactual
columns.disp_brier, disp_logloss, brier_overrun,: Disposition probability and duration predictive scores
columns.p_overrun_7d, y_overrun_7d: Predicted probability and realized binary indicator of 7-day SLA overrun
columns.y_disp_idx, y_log_dur_sc, q05_dur, q50_d: Realized disposition index, scaled log duration, and predictive duration quantiles

columns.event_idx, ticket_hash, rev, stage_label: Anonymized ticket revision metadata (cadence 0h / +6h / +48h; Wave-2 cold-start flag)
columns.es_mixed, es_prior_cf, disp_brier, disp_: Joint mixed Energy Score and component scores
columns.p_overrun_7d, y_overrun_7d, triage_cost_: 7-day SLA overrun calibration columns and asymmetric 5:1 triage cost

sf_311_post2026_09_revisions_trace.csv.columns: Identical schema to chicago_311_post2026_09_revisions_trace.csv with San Francisco checkpoint cadence (0h / +1h / +6h).
